Higgsfield MCP connects Higgsfield to AI agents. Connect once and generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent, without leaving your agent. The main difference from generating on the web: MCP always uses credits. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai, so anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates.

## What is Higgsfield MCP?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open protocol that lets AI agents connect to external services and call their tools. Higgsfield MCP is a connector that lets you generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Higgsfield directly inside Claude or another MCP-compatible agent. It isn't the Higgsfield API: MCP connects to your existing account and uses your existing plan credits, with no API key required. For building generation into your own product with per-request billing, see What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started?

Because MCP connects programmatically, using Higgsfield through it falls under the Developer Terms in the Terms of Use. In short: keep your connection secure, and you're responsible for anything an agent generates through your account.

**MCP connector URL:** https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp

## How is MCP different from the web?

The most important difference is credit behavior: everything generated through MCP deducts credits, regardless of your plan.

How is MCP different from the web?

| Criteria | Web (higgsfield.ai) | MCP |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unlimited model access | Yes, where included in plan | No, always deducts credits |
| Free generations | Yes, where included in plan | No |
| Credit cost | Standard rates | Standard rates |
| Generations appear in Assets | Yes | Yes |
| Access to models | Yes | Yes |

## Do Unlimited models and free generations work through MCP?

No. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai: they're intended for manual use, not for automated or programmatic generation. Anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates. To generate on a model where your plan includes Unlimited access without spending credits, do it on the web at higgsfield.ai.

## What can I do through MCP?

* **Image and video generation** across the Higgsfield model lineup, with results saved to your Assets.
* **Marketing Studio:** paste a product link and get ready video ads built on a set of presets.
* **Ad Multiplier:** turn a reference ad and your product or character images into new versions of the same ad with a different product, location, hook, or CTA.
* **Genjutsu:** Motion Transfer, Object Swap, and Restyle for video.
* **Upscale:** raise the resolution and quality of your images and videos. How Upscale works on the website is covered in How do I use Upscale?
* **Soul characters:** train a character from photos and reuse it across generations.
* **Higgsfield Audio** and credit balance checks.
* **Asset Library:** browse your past generations and use them as references.

For the full list of operations and how to phrase requests to your agent, see How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent?

Higgsfield provides one integration point for generative media models. Submit a request to a model endpoint, then poll for the result or receive a webhook when processing finishes.

## Make a request

Every model uses the same authentication and asynchronous request lifecycle. The JSON body depends on the selected model.
Start with Genjutsu motion transfer. Replace the example media URLs with publicly accessible URLs for your own video and reference image. The source video must be at least 4 seconds long.

```
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield/genjutsu/motion-transfer/v1.0 \
  --header "Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "video_url": "https://example.com/input.mp4",
    "image_urls": ["https://example.com/input.jpg"]
  }'
```

The API immediately returns a request identifier and links for checking or canceling the request.

```
{
  "status": "queued",
  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
  "status_url": "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/status",
  "cancel_url": "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/cancel"
}
```

## Choose your path

Output files are available for at least seven days. Download completed output to your own storage for long-term retention.

## Build a prototype

Use the Python or TypeScript SDK to submit a request and wait for its result.

## Ship to production

Learn the request lifecycle, polling, webhooks, errors, and limits.

## Upload media

Upload input files to Higgsfield storage before generation.

Output files are available for at least seven days. Download completed output to your own storage for long-term retention.

Generation is asynchronous. A successful submission creates a request and returns immediately while the work continues in the background.

## Request lifecycle

| Status | Terminal | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | No | The request is waiting to start and may still be canceled. |
| `in_progress` | No | Generation has started and can no longer be canceled. |
| `completed` | Yes | Output URLs are available in the response. |
| `failed` | Yes | Generation failed. The response may include an `error`. |
| `nsfw` | Yes | Input or output was rejected by content moderation. |
| `canceled` | Yes | The request was canceled before processing started. |

Store the `request_id` as soon as a request is accepted. It is the stable identifier used by polling, cancellation, webhook deduplication, and support.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` with generation submissions so an ambiguous timeout can be retried without creating a duplicate request.

## Initial response

```
{
  "status": "queued",
  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
  "status_url": "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/status",
  "cancel_url": "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/cancel",
  "expires_after": 604800
}
```

Use the URLs from the response instead of constructing them manually. `expires_after` is how long, in seconds, the request’s data is kept after it finishes. See Data retention and deletion.

## Completed output

The output field depends on the model’s output type.

```
{
  "status": "completed",
  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
  "expires_at": "2026-10-31T12:05:12.481Z",
  "images": [
    { "url": "https://cdn.example.com/image-1.jpg" },
    { "url": "https://cdn.example.com/image-2.jpg" }
  ]
}
```

```
{
  "status": "completed",
  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
  "video": {
    "url": "https://cdn.example.com/video.mp4"
  }
}
```

```
{
  "status": "completed",
  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
  "audio": {
    "url": "https://cdn.example.com/audio.mp3"
  },
  "audios": [
    { "url": "https://cdn.example.com/audio.mp3" }
  ]
}
```

Some video and 3D operations can return additional artifacts such as `zip`, `mov`, `jsx`, `fbx`, or `ply`.
Once a request finishes, its status response includes `expires_at`: the time after which its files are deleted and output URLs stop working.

## Cancel a request

Cancellation is available only while every job in the request remains queued.

```
curl --request POST \
  --url "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/${REQUEST_ID}/cancel" \
  --header "Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}"
```

A successful cancellation returns `202 Accepted` with an empty body. If processing has started, the API returns `400 Bad Request`.

## Delete a request

Delete a finished request’s files, prompt and parameters immediately:

```
curl --request DELETE \
  --url "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/${REQUEST_ID}" \
  --header "Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}"
```

The API returns `200 OK` with `{"request_id": "...", "status": "deleted"}`, also when the request was already deleted. A request that is still `queued` or `in_progress` returns `409 Conflict`. Billing records are kept.

Request data is kept for seven days after the request finishes, or less if you shorten the retention. Copy completed media to your own storage if you need it for longer.
